metadata.title: AI Data Center Timelines CSV
metadata.description: Normalized U.S. operational IT-power and secondary H100-equivalent audit data attributable to Epoch AI timelines.

sources.title: AI Data Center Timelines CSV
sources.notes: Observed quarters use the latest operational state at each cutoff; forward quarters use the latest expected/projected state dated by each cutoff. U.S. geography is joined from Epoch’s data-center registry.

update.method: agent-assisted source extraction and normalization with human review
update.notes: Refresh this file from its single metadata.sources URL in a new dated snapshot; never revise a published snapshot.

results.summary: 40 explicit numeric measurement(s); 20 item(s) affect the countdown.

measurements.metric: U.S. operational or projected AI IT power
measurements.subject: 2024-Q1
measurements.caveat: observed_quarter_end: observed_quarter_end: Latest published state on or before cutoff for each Epoch-covered U.S. site. U.S. sites are selected through Epoch's data-center registry; IT power is the physical source metric and H100e is retained as a productivity audit bridge.
